# Giridhari Pal — Backend & Systems Engineer

> Python and Rust backend engineer in Gandhinagar, Gujarat, India with 3+ years of professional experience (since Sep 2023; earlier internship and consultancy work from Nov 2021). Builds scalable APIs, microservices, Kafka/MQTT real-time pipelines and IoT energy systems. Currently Junior Research Fellow at Dhirubhai Ambani University. Open to Backend Engineer, Python Developer, Software Engineer and DevOps roles (remote, hybrid or on-site: Kolkata, Noida, Gurugram, Delhi, Ahmedabad / Gandhinagar).

- Freelance Backend Engineer / Technical Consultant, NUMENTRIX (Nov 2024 – Jul 2025): ERP systems, leave management, ZWCAD-to-inventory desktop app, TensorFlow OCR for HDFC Bank.
- DevOps & SDE Consultant Engineer, RC Labs (Sep 2023 – Oct 2024): Battery Management System backend, millions of data points daily at sub-100ms latency, Kafka, gRPC, Grafana, Docker.
- DevOps & SDE Intern, RC Labs (Sep 2022 – Aug 2023): PyQt desktop and Django web battery-monitoring apps, encrypted MQTT.
- Software Developer (Consultancy Project), RC Labs (Nov 2021 – Aug 2022): Grafana dashboards, Python ETL, Node-RED ingestion.
